Key Responsibilities & Achievements: • Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.


Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency. GIRISH MORAB
Seeking a challenging role in product-based companies, driving digital transformation, product innovation, and
revenue growth through strategic program management, AI-driven insights, and agile execution.
SYNOPSIS
digital transformation, and enterprise technology, in the Fintech, Retail, Energy & Utility domains by relentlessly driving for
innovation, growth, and impact defining every endeavor.
As a Senior Program Manager at PayPal, steering high-stakes programs with precision, ensuring seamless execution across credit
collections for consumers and merchants, enterprise, risk and regulatory.
A leader in cloud computing, Voice Agentic AI, Agentic AI Chatbot, data engineering, and regulatory compliance, digital payments,
credit collections, BNPL, consumer lending platform, merchant lending platform, and fraud detection.
Bridging technology with business strategy, wielding expertise in governance, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement, and
securing high-value partnerships across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.
An agile transformation specialist, optimizing workflows, fostering collaboration, and driving operational resilience in
global financial
ecosystems.
Mastering the art of turning red-status projects into success stories, having led multi-million-dollar portfolios and scaled
operations from $2.5M to $10M, while managing teams of 100+ experts.
AREAS OF EXPERTISE & INTEREST
Program & Project Management: Proven track record of successfully delivering complex programs, including both new initiatives and
red-status recoveries, ensuring seamless execution and value realization.
Strategic Planning & Agile Transformation: Skilled in driving product & technology planning through dependency commit in Jira,
“Now”, “Next” and “Later” refinement of roadmap, agile methodologies, lean tools, and data-driven decision-making to improve financial
product delivery and operational resilience.
End-to-End FinTech Product Lifecycle Management: Deep understanding of digital payments, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), Collections
platforms for Consumers and Merchants, and AI-powered financial insights, ensuring seamless product development, compliance, and
market adoption.
Technology Leadership: Led high-impact programs leveraging Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Google
Visualization, AI/ML-driven financial analytics,
Informatica IICS, Full Stack Web & Mobile App Development, DevOps, SIEM, OpenText, and SAP to enhance financial product offerings
and regulatory compliance.
Migration Expertise: Led high-impact platform-migration and cloud-migration programs to successful completion.
Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Established efficient workflows for delivering projects/programs in payment
systems, collections, digital lending, credit risk assessment, and financial data processing, fostering a culture of continuous improvement,
enhanced collaboration, and real-time visibility into operations.
Revenue Growth & Business Expansion: Managed $10M in annual revenue and a team of 100 experts, successfully scaling a FinTech
account from $2.5M to $10M by optimizing product delivery, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring regulatory alignment.
Global Markets & Client Engagement: Extensive experience in ecosystems across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, working with major
organizations such as PayPal, Chubb, Shell, Thomson Reuters, Thames Water, Nike, and Hanes. Six years of on-site experience in the USA
